nodes.name: Claim the case
nodes.notes: Claims the case and counts the try, but only if its status and attempts are still what the Dispatcher saw. Returns the row if claimed, an empty item if not.

nodes.name: Read the case as it is now

parameters.jsonOutput: ={{ JSON.stringify({ caseId: $('Case from the Dispatcher').first().json.caseId, caseKey: $json.caseKey ?? '', claimed: false, status: $json.status ?? '', reasonCode: $json.reasonCode ?? '', outcome: $json.outcome ?? '', urgent: $json.urgent === true }) }}

nodes.name: Find the lead row
nodes.notes: Only matters for joint rows: the stand-in copies check 2 (a joint row takes its result from its lead row).

nodes.name: Choose the pretend result
nodes.notes: Why Code: test stand-in. Every pretend rule in one place (chosen from the tenant's name); a Switch with a Set per branch would be much longer. Rules are listed in docs/build-notes/track-B.md.

nodes.name: Answer: left in progress
nodes.notes: Simulates a crash: the case is left in_progress, as if the Performer stopped part-way.

parameters.jsonOutput: ={{ JSON.stringify({ caseId: $('Case from the Dispatcher').first().json.caseId, caseKey: $('Claim the case').first().json.caseKey, claimed: true, status: 'in_progress', reasonCode: '', outcome: '', urgent: false }) }}
